explanations.nuit-etoilee: Vincent van Gogh painted 'The Starry Night' in 1889, from the window of his room at the asylum in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.
explanations.joconde: Léonard de Vinci painted the 'Mona Lisa' in the early 16th century; the painting is displayed at the Louvre Museum.
explanations.le-cri: Edvard Munch painted 'The Scream' in 1893, an iconic work of Expressionism.
explanations.naissance-de-venus: Sandro Botticelli painted 'The Birth of Venus' around 1485, a major work of the Italian Renaissance.
explanations.nympheas: Claude Monet painted his 'Water Lilies' series from the garden of his home in Giverny, a high point of Impressionism.
explanations.liberte-guidant-le-peuple: Eugène Delacroix painted 'Liberty Leading the People' in 1830, to commemorate the July Revolution.
explanations.dejeuner-sur-l-herbe: Édouard Manet painted 'Luncheon on the Grass' in 1863; the painting caused a scandal at the Salon des Refusés.
explanations.jeune-fille-a-la-perle: Johannes Vermeer painted 'Girl with a Pearl Earring' around 1665, nicknamed the 'Mona Lisa of the North.'
explanations.le-baiser: Gustav Klimt painted 'The Kiss' between 1907 and 1908, a signature work of his Golden Phase and the Vienna Secession.
explanations.american-gothic: Grant Wood painted 'American Gothic' in 1930, which became an icon of American Regionalism.

About.title: About Quizmify
About.intro: Discover how Quizmify is transforming the way people learn through AI-powered quiz generation and intelligent performance tracking.
About.descriptionEnglish: Quizmify is an AI-powered quiz platform that generates quizzes on any topic in seconds, tracks your performance, and turns your mistakes into practice opportunities.
About.descriptionSpanish: Quizmify es una plataforma de quizzes potenciada por IA que genera preguntas sobre cualquier tema en segundos, registra tu desempeño y convierte tus errores en oportunidades de práctica.
About.dataUsageDesc: Quizmify processes your quiz responses and learning data to personalize your experience and improve the platform. Your data is used for:
About.dataPoint1: Generating personalized quizzes tailored to your learning level and interests
About.dataPoint2: Tracking your performance metrics and progress over time
About.dataPoint3: Identifying topics where you need more practice and creating targeted review sessions
About.dataPoint4: Improving our AI models to deliver better quiz generation and recommendations
